name: blip-send
title: Blip Send
description: Send files from Finder or File Explorer to your Blip devices and contacts, and manage transfers, without opening the Blip window.
author: andrew_beniston

commands.name: send
commands.title: Send Files with Blip
commands.subtitle: Blip
commands.description: Send the items selected in Finder or File Explorer, or files you choose, to one of your devices or contacts.

commands.name: transfers
commands.title: Blip Transfers
commands.subtitle: Blip
commands.description: See live progress, accept or decline incoming transfers, and pause, resume or cancel.

commands.name: people
commands.title: Blip Devices and Contacts
commands.subtitle: Blip
commands.description: Browse your devices and contacts, rename or remove a device, and search people on Blip.

preferences.name: afterSend
preferences.title: After Sending
preferences.description: What Raycast does once the transfer has started.

preferences.name: savePath
preferences.title: Save Incoming Files To
preferences.description: Folder used when you accept a transfer from Raycast. Leave empty to use Blip's own setting.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
